blocks.x: Tell me, while you were working with Louis Armstrong's band, Red Allen was in that band with you. Did Red Allen get much
Yeah, during intermission. We would take intermissions and then Red would play 30 minutes with the band while we were resting.
The same way they responded to Louis Armstrong's playing?
Yes, very good. You might as well get things straight, very good.
How did Red Allen look on Louis Armstrong? I mean, did Red Allen ever look at him and say, "Wow, he can really play! He can do things that I can't do."
I don't know how to explain that. Red's got a funny disposition so I can't explain that.
